en: Improved the speed of a session's first Bash command: shell start-up files may now run before it's approved, even if it's refused; set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SHELL_HEAD_START=1` to turn this off
zh: 改进会话首条 Bash 命令的速度：shell 启动文件现在可能在命令获批前运行，即使命令被拒绝；设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SHELL_HEAD_START=1` 可关闭此行为
